Package index

Calculer

Chaque fonction appelle un moteur existant (stats, ppcor, psych, correlation) et ajuste les p-values sur une famille explicite.

cor_test_matrix()
Correlation and p-value matrices of all pairs (pairwise complete observations)
cor_cross()
Cross correlations X x Y (e.g. biomarkers x scores), optionally partial
partial_cor_test() partial_rank_cor()
Correlation test between x and y, partial if covariates are given
cor_binary_effects()
Effect sizes of binary variables on continuous scores

Graphiques

Objets ggplot, avec sous-titre (méthode, moteur, N) et légende de lecture.

plot_cor_heatmap()
Lower-triangular heatmap of a correlation matrix
plot_cor_cross()
Heatmap of cross correlations X x Y, optionally partial
plot_cor_pair()
Plot of one correlation, with its coefficient, CI and test in the subtitle

Tableaux

Tableaux gt, même échelle de couleurs que les heatmaps, notes de bas de tableau.

tbl_cor_binary()
Table of the effect sizes of binary variables
tbl_cor_cross()
Table of cross correlations X x Y (wide: one row per predictor, one column per score)
tbl_cor_long()
Long table of correlations: one row per pair, with CI, raw and adjusted p
tbl_cor_matrix()
Table of a correlation matrix (lower triangle), same layout as the heatmap

Notes de lecture et utilitaires

cor_binary_note()
Reading note for a correlation involving a binary (0/1) variable
cor_var_type()
Type of a variable for a correlation
as_cor_numeric()
Numeric coding of a variable for a correlation
mark_binary()
Add a marker (default " [0/1]") to the labels of binary variables
p_to_stars()
Significance stars of p-values
theme_pub()
ggplot2 theme of the corrkit figures
COR_PAL
Palette of the correlation heatmaps and tables (named low / high, white at 0)

Données d’exemple

simulate_cor_data()
Simulated biomarkers, clinical scores and covariates
